faqs.question: What is an NFT?
faqs.answer: NFT (Non-Fungible Token) is a unique digital asset on the blockchain representing ownership of items like art, music, collectibles, and virtual real estate. Each NFT is unique and cannot be replicated.

faqs.question: Where can I buy NFTs?
faqs.answer: Popular NFT marketplaces include OpenSea (largest general marketplace), Blur (for traders), Magic Eden (Solana), and Foundation (curated art). Each platform has different fees and features.

faqs.question: How do I create an NFT?
faqs.answer: To create an NFT: 1) Create digital artwork or content, 2) Choose a blockchain (Ethereum, Solana, etc.), 3) Select a marketplace like OpenSea, 4) Connect your wallet and upload your content, 5) Set pricing and list for sale.
